blocks.title: Welcome
blocks.sub: Oh, hi there! You found my website...

blocks.html:
This is a website that is hosted on a off-grid portable network, it isn't connected to the world wide web. 
The website files are stored on a small portable device that creates a web access point and serves this page. 
Why? Good question... I don't really know why I did this. Call it an experiment to see if it was possible.
Anyhow, I hope you have a great day, here is a picture of a cute kitten.
